title: The Share of the Management Fee Charged while a Micro Market Stands Shut
content:
Where a client of the Unattended Micro Market Program also holds an active contract under the Workplace Cafe Management Program, the cafe carries the dining programme while the market is shut, and only a share of the market's management fee is charged. The client subsidy the cafe has met over the trailing year, read from the cafe's own subsidy drawdown entries, settles which share.

## Conditions and shares

**The pooled fee share of 40 per cent** is taken where the client holds a workplace cafe contract standing active, and that cafe has met 15000 USD or more of client subsidy over the twelve months to the day the settlement is raised, the cafe carrying the dining programme while the market is shut.

**The light pooled fee share of 70 per cent** is taken where the client holds a workplace cafe contract standing active, and that cafe has met less than 15000 USD of client subsidy over those twelve months.

**Where the client holds no workplace cafe contract, or holds one that does not stand active**, no such pooled share is taken.

## The boundary

The cafe pooled floor is 15000 USD of client subsidy met over the trailing twelve months. A cafe that has met exactly 15000 USD is at or above the floor and takes the first condition; a cafe that has met 14999.99 USD is below it and takes the second.

*Hypothetical.* A client holding an active Workplace Cafe Management Program contract whose cafe subsidy drawdown entries total 21000 USD over the trailing year, on a market format printing a management fee of 980.00 USD each month for a closure charged as one month, is charged 392.00 USD of management fee. Had those entries totalled 8000 USD, the charge would be 686.00 USD.
